Sourcesrc/website/public/wasm/burger/luiskr_burger.js
UX surfaceBoot surfaces: what the user sees first on each bundle.

Members

Burger

Public wasm surface — one burger canvas per instance.

frame

frame — one animation tick: pack the 8-f32 block, write, draw.

  • @param dt Seconds since the previous call.
  • @param {number} dt

init

init — acquire device + compile the pipeline. Rejection → JS keeps the DOM/CSS burger; mounting can never regress the page.

  • @param canvas The widget's dedicated canvas.
  • @param device The shared GPUDevice (one per page, from the JS bridge).
  • @returns Ok on a live surface, Err(JsValue) on failure.
  • @param {HTMLCanvasElement} canvas
  • @param {GPUDevice} device

constructor

Burger::new — un-initialized widget; init must follow.

resize

resize — canvas-bitmap change → surface re-configure + the DEVICE-pixel size that becomes rect.zw (the frag→uv divisor; frag arrives in device px, so the divisor must too, or every widget renders squashed at DPR ≠ 1).

  • @param w Device-pixel width (element CSS px × DPR).
  • @param h Device-pixel height.
  • @param {number} w
  • @param {number} h

set_dark

set_dark — the theme lerp: 0 = light, 1 = dark. Clamped — the shader lerps ink colors on this factor.

  • @param v Theme darkness 0..1.
  • @param {number} v

set_size

set_size — the canvas's CSS-pixel size (the res field — the shader's design-unit domain; uv * res yields CSS px).

  • @param w Canvas width in CSS pixels.
  • @param h Canvas height in CSS pixels.
  • @param {number} w
  • @param {number} h
